exercises.title: Find an import cycle
exercises.task: To compile a package, the compiler needs the packages it imports compiled first. If parser imports ast, ast imports types and types imports parser, there is no first one: Go refuses with import cycle not allowed and prints the cycle. Return one cycle as a path that starts and ends on the same package, like [a b c a], or nil if there is none. DFS finds it: a cycle is an edge back to a node still on the current path.
hints: Three states per node: not visited, on the current path (in progress), done. An edge to an in-progress node closes a cycle.
Keep the current path in a slice (push on entry, pop on exit): when you find the edge back to node x, the cycle is the part of the path from x, plus x again.
Start a DFS from every node not yet done (in sorted order, for a predictable answer): the graph may have several parts.
